positioning: evidence-driven AI infra learning and desktop digital twin practice platform for foundation-to-advanced engineering capability

tasks.title: Redefine expert claims
acceptance: source_backed_draft_review_required is not rendered as approved expert content
technical, lab, and assessment reviewer obligations are visible

tasks.title: Create tri-review approval workflow
acceptance: each unit can hold technical_reviewed, lab_validated, assessment_validated, approved, or deprecated state
review decisions are auditable and separated from generated content

tasks.title: Upgrade real lifecycle lab count
acceptance: real_lifecycle labs increase from 2 to at least 10
Docker, kind, Prometheus, vLLM, Jenkins, GPU OOM, and rollback loops have bounded cleanup proof

tasks.title: Bind mastery to Evidence Bundle
acceptance: unit completion requires explicit evidence refs when Twin practice exists
evidence refs persist in the AI infra learning workspace

tasks.title: Upgrade diagnosis scoring rubric
acceptance: diagnosis gate checks claim shape instead of minimum length only
future scorer checks evidence-claim consistency, candidate hypotheses, exclusion process, safe fix, and validation method

tasks.title: Add source document drill
acceptance: learner must reference at least one candidate trusted document
answer must connect source, evidence requirement, and claim boundary

tasks.title: Add unknown challenge modes
acceptance: Learn, Guided Practice, Independent Lab, Incident Challenge, and Capstone modes are available
independent and incident modes hide failure-mode and expected-claim hints

tasks.title: Add AI Infra Software Engineering path
acceptance: path covers API/controller/operator design, idempotency, retries, schema compatibility, CI, and tests
path includes source-backed units, quizzes, diagnosis drills, and at least one capstone

tasks.title: Expand deep paths beyond four units
acceptance: Kubernetes, inference serving, GPU SRE, distributed training, networking, and storage paths have complexity-proportional unit counts
core role paths target 12 to 20 units instead of fixed four-unit shells

tasks.title: Add real multi-node calibration profile
acceptance: RTX 4050, RTX 5090, L20, and CX6 device profiles are reported separately
NCCL, DDP, topology, rank failure, checkpoint pressure, and multi-replica inference are calibrated on real hardware when available

tasks.title: Add spaced repetition and retention tracking
acceptance: review queue shows due, soon, and later units
last reviewed state persists in workspace

tasks.title: Add pre, post, transfer, and expert-agreement evaluation
acceptance: pre/post tests measure immediate gain
transfer tests use unseen incidents
automatic scorer agreement with expert scoring is reported

tasks.title: Align with leading learning methods
acceptance: course guide exposes mastery learning, retrieval and spacing, active learning, deliberate practice, and project or scenario-based learning alignment
Tutor WebUI renders method alignment and remaining gaps
alignment items remain source-backed draft until expert review

tasks.title: Add AI Infra Security and Governance path
acceptance: path covers model artifact provenance, runtime permission boundaries, secret handling, supply-chain scanning, and audit evidence
units include source drills, unsafe-action refusal cases, and expert-review rubrics

tasks.title: Add AI Infra Networking path
acceptance: path covers service discovery, ingress, DNS, east-west traffic, NCCL/network topology, and latency evidence
labs distinguish local emulation, single-node proof, and multi-node calibrated claims

tasks.title: Add AI Infra Storage and Data Path path
acceptance: path covers dataset staging, checkpoint pressure, object storage, PVC behavior, cache locality, and recovery evidence
capstone requires bounded throughput and durability claims with source and lab evidence

tasks.title: Add GPU Systems and CUDA Operations path
acceptance: path covers driver/runtime compatibility, CUDA visibility, memory pressure, MIG/MPS concepts, utilization, and thermal/power caveats
real labs collect read-only GPU profile evidence before any workload claim

tasks.title: Add Platform Economics and Capacity Planning path
acceptance: path covers tokens-per-dollar, utilization, queueing tradeoffs, reservation assumptions, and benchmark-to-cost claim boundaries
assessment includes cost/capacity diagnosis from evidence bundles

tasks.title: Upgrade spaced review to adaptive recall strength
acceptance: review scheduling uses learner result history instead of fixed intervals only
weak skills trigger shorter review intervals and targeted remediation

tasks.title: Add error taxonomy and remediation routing
acceptance: wrong answers and weak diagnoses map to concept, evidence, source, safety, or reasoning error types
Tutor selects the next drill from the error type and learner history

tasks.title: Add operational brief review loop
acceptance: capstone and incident responses can be submitted as reviewable operational briefs
review feedback is separated from generated hints and bound to evidence refs

tasks.title: Refine native Tutor stepper presentation
acceptance: standard learning defaults to ordered Continue flow without requiring repeated chat prompts
each objective displays one current action at a time: learn, quiz, diagnosis, source drill, lab, or reflection

tasks.title: Add learner and expert dashboards
acceptance: learner dashboard shows mastery, due reviews, evidence gaps, and next action
expert dashboard shows source-backed draft state, review queue, and approval bottlenecks
